post.description: Builds Jev state from the sample payload, calls Jev once (rate-limited) and returns the typed answer plus the verdict. Mismatched question/condition types are rejected with 422.

get.description: Streams log.processed, flag.created and consumer.status events. Send Last-Event-ID to replay missed events from the ring buffer; a heartbeat comment keeps idle connections open.
